Previous page

  1. Classic 25L Backpack

    More gear, same Carhartt grit. The Classic 25L hauls 25 liters of hardworking storage built from rugged fabric with Durable Water Repellent. A 16" laptop sleeve and reflective details built to last.

  2. Classic 21L Backpack

    Built rugged for the long haul. The Classic 21L is made from durable fabric with Durable Water Repellent. A 15" laptop sleeve, front zip organization, and reflective details keep you ready.

  3. Utility 27L Backpack

    Step up your carry. The Utility 27L is built from heavy-duty fabric with Durable Water Repellent. A 15" laptop sleeve, tablet sleeve, and padded air mesh back panel built for the longest days.

  4. Utility 28L Backpack

    Two compartments. Zero compromise. The Utility 28L is built from heavy-duty fabric with Durable Water Repellent and FastDry technology. Laptop compartment, tablet sleeve, power pack pocket built in.

  5. Utility 35L Backpack

    Built for the big days. The Utility 35L packs three compartments and a 17" laptop sleeve into rugged fabric with Durable Water Repellent. FastDry keeps you dry. Power pack pocket keeps you connected.

  6. 21L Top Load Backpack

    Open wide. Work hard. The 21L Top-Load's wide-mouth double-zip puts everything in plain sight. Built from durable fabric with a coated canvas base. Carries a 17" laptop. Reflective webbing built in.

Next page

From compact daypacks to full-size haulers, every Carhartt backpack is built with the same standard. Durable Water Repellent protection, hardworking storage, and durability that holds up day after day, shift after shift.

  • What size laptop does it fit?

    The Classic 25L Backpack fits laptops up to 15 inches. The dedicated padded sleeve keeps your device protected and easy to access from the job site to the office.

  • What is the capacity?

    This pack carries 25 liters, sized for your 15" laptop plus a change of clothes. Enough room for your gear, your tech, and everything a full day demands without needing a second bag.

  • How many compartments and pockets does it have?

    You get a large main compartment with a dedicated 15" laptop sleeve, a front zippered compartment with built-in organization, and two side pockets so there's a place for everything.

  • Is it waterproof or water-resistant?

    Built with heavy-duty fabric and a Durable Water Repellent finish, this pack sheds light rain so your gear stays dry when the weather turns. Water beads up and rolls off.

  • How do you clean it?

    Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid machine washing. Air dry completely before storing.

Backpacks. One standard. Built Carhartt tough.

Every Carhartt backpack is built from heavy-duty fabric with Durable Water Repellent and reinforced where it matters most. Organized storage, padded protection, and hardworking carry from the first day to the longest shift.

Product Description

Looking for a travel backpack that holds up on the road and in real life? The Carhartt 25L is built for all of it, the commute, the campus, the weekend trip, and the job site. It's a great backpack for women and men who want durability without sacrificing style or organization. Whether you need a reliable travel backpack for women, a rugged travel backpack for men, or a polished work backpack for women, the 25L has the space and the structure to get you there. The dedicated 16" laptop sleeve keeps your tech protected, Rain Defender DWR coating sheds light rain before it becomes a problem, and the padded mesh back panel keeps you comfortable from first bag to last drop-off. A perfect backpack for college students during this back to school season. Front organizer pocket and a spacious main compartment mean everything has a place. No digging, no guessing. 13" × 18" × 8" | 25L

    5 out of 5 stars
    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Bought for My Son in College – Durable & Functional
    Reviewed in the United States on January 8, 2025
    Size: One SizeColor: Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I recently purchased the Carhartt 25L Classic Backpack for my son, who just started college, and it has been an excellent choice. This backpack is not only stylish but also incredibly functional and durable, making it perfect for his busy campus life. Here’s why I highly recommend it:

    What We Loved:

    Durable and Water-Resistant Material: The backpack is made from 600-denier polyester with Rain Defender™ durable water repellent, which means it can handle unexpected rain or spills without damaging the contents inside. My son doesn’t have to worry about his books or laptop getting wet when walking across campus.

    Spacious Main Compartment: The large main compartment is perfect for carrying textbooks, notebooks, and other essentials. It’s roomy enough to fit everything he needs for a full day of classes.

    Dedicated Laptop Sleeve: The built-in 15-inch laptop sleeve is a standout feature. It keeps his laptop secure and protected, which is essential for a college student who relies on their computer for assignments and studying.

    Multiple Pockets for Organization: The backpack includes a large exterior pocket and two side pockets, which are great for organizing smaller items like chargers, water bottles, or snacks. My son loves how easy it is to keep everything in its place.

    Comfortable to Wear: The adjustable shoulder straps make it comfortable to carry, even when it’s fully loaded. My son has mentioned that it feels lightweight and doesn’t strain his shoulders, even after a long day.

    Stylish and Versatile: The sleek design and neutral colors make it suitable for both casual and professional settings. It’s a great all-around backpack that works for class, the gym, or even weekend trips.

    What Could Be Improved:

    The only minor downside is that the side pockets are a bit snug for larger water bottles, but they still work well for standard-sized bottles or smaller items.

    Final Thoughts:

    The Carhartt 25L Classic Backpack is a fantastic choice for college students or anyone looking for a durable, water-resistant, and functional backpack. It’s spacious, well-organized, and built to last, making it perfect for my son’s busy college life. He loves it, and I feel confident knowing he has a reliable bag to carry his essentials.

    Highly recommend for students or professionals who need a sturdy and stylish backpack!

    I got this backpack because my boyfriend and I love hiking, but I needed something that would also work for school and my job in education—and this has been perfect for both.

    It’s incredibly versatile. I use it daily as a student and work backpack, and when we want to go hiking, I can easily swap out my school and work items and use the same bag outdoors without any issues. Everything is easy to organize, carry, and access.

    The material feels durable and well-made, clearly designed to handle both indoor and outdoor use. The straps are comfortable, the zippers feel sturdy, and it holds everything I need without feeling bulky or awkward.

    I also love that it has a simple, timeless look that works in professional settings but still feels appropriate for outdoor activities. It’s rare to find a backpack that transitions this well between everyday life and hiking, and this one truly does.

    If you’re looking for a backpack that can handle work, school, and outdoor adventures, this is a great option.

    I really like this backpack. I have used many over the years, and the last one I bought ended up having so many pockets I kept losing track of where things were - real overkill! This one has just the right amount of space for what I need, and my 13" laptop fits with plenty of room to spare. It feels durable and sturdy. Although I haven't had it long, I have used Carhartt products in the past and know the fabric lasts. Plus, I love the undeniable Carhartt adobe-brown color! The zippers are solid and smooth, although I don't love that there is a lip of fabric over them - I'm sure it's for security, but for my purposes, I'd rather the zippers be easier to grasp. It is comfortable to wear, and carry. I wore it in the rain a couple of times, and true to Carhartt's claims, the water ran right off. I am taking off one star because the bottom of the bag doesn't have much padding, and I felt a little uncomfortable putting my laptop in and plopping it down on the floor. I rolled up an old dish towel and put it in the bottom of the laptop pouch, and that does the trick, but to be perfect, it could use some cushioning down there. Overall, I'm very pleased with this backpack.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Ein echter Allrounder – Perfekt für Schule, Sport und Freizeit!
    Reviewed in Germany on January 11, 2026
    Size: One SizeColor: Black

    Wir haben diesen schwarzen Rucksack jetzt seit einiger Zeit im Einsatz und sind absolut zufrieden. Er ist ein echtes Multitalent und sieht zudem noch recht schick und zeitlos aus.

    Nutzung in der Schule: Der Rucksack bietet genügend Platz für Hefte, Bücher und Tablett. Besonders wichtig war uns das Laptop-/Tablet-Fach: Es ist gut gepolstert, sodass das Gerät sicher verstaut ist und nicht im Hauptfach hin- und herrutscht. Auch bei schwerer Beladung lässt er sich dank der angenehmen Schultergurte noch gut tragen.

    Freizeit & Sport: Nach der Schule wird er manchmal auch direkt weiter für den Sport genutzt oder für andere freizeitaktivitäten. Das Design ist schlicht genug, um zu jedem Outfit zu passen, aber robust genug, um auch mal am Spielfeldrand zu liegen. Selbst Sportkleidung und eine Trinkflasche finden problemlos neben den Schulsachen Platz.

    Qualität: Das Material wirkt bisher strapazierfähig und die Reißverschlüsse laufen flüssig, ohne zu haken. Da er komplett schwarz ist, sieht man Schmutz kaum – und wenn doch mal etwas dran ist, lässt er sich leicht abwischen.

    Fazit: Ein klasse Rucksack für alle, die ein zuverlässiges Modell für den Alltag suchen. Er kombiniert Funktionalität (besonders durch das Laptopfach) mit einem modernen Look. Absolute Kaufempfehlung!

About this Item

  • 25L CARHARTT LAPTOP BACKPACK | A backpack for men and women who mean business. This no-nonsense Carhartt backpack carries all your daily essentials with Carhartt-tough durability. From the classroom to the job site, it's the only bag you'll need.
  • DENIER POLYESTER | Crafted from durable 600-denier polyester, this backpack is built to last. The integrated rain defender technology ensures that your belongings stay dry, making it an ideal companion for your urban commutes or outdoor excursions
  • 16-Inch LAPTOP SLEEVE | Featuring a front zipper compartment and main zippered compartment with a dedicated 16" laptop sleeve, whether you're carrying textbooks, tech gadgets, or travel essentials, everything has its place within this versatile pack. Great college backpack for all things back to school
  • FEATURES | Front zippered organization compartment provides four additional mesh sleeves along with a key clip to keep your accessories organized and on hand
  • COMFORTABLE and ADJUSTABLE FIT | The backpack features a padded mesh back panel and contour fit adjustable shoulder straps. Backpack measures at 13”X 18”X 8” Volume| 25L

Product Description

Looking for a travel backpack that holds up on the road and in real life? The Carhartt 25L is built for all of it, the commute, the campus, the weekend trip, and the job site. It's a great backpack for women and men who want durability without sacrificing style or organization. Whether you need a reliable travel backpack for women, a rugged travel backpack for men, or a polished work backpack for women, the 25L has the space and the structure to get you there. The dedicated 16" laptop sleeve keeps your tech protected, Rain Defender DWR coating sheds light rain before it becomes a problem, and the padded mesh back panel keeps you comfortable from first bag to last drop-off. A perfect backpack for college students during this back to school season. Front organizer pocket and a spacious main compartment mean everything has a place. No digging, no guessing. 13" × 18" × 8" | 25L
